test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 10 persons increases by 7.9 kg when a new person replaces one of them weighing 20 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total weight increase = Total persons × Average increase

Total increase = 10 × 7.9 = 79 kg

New person's weight = Replaced person's weight + Total increase

New person's weight = 20 + 79 = 99 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 99 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b32c2bcfd844022098093e1275e6d3bf0f2a842bc51559356d090fb979779892.png] 

**Given:**

Number of persons = 10

Weight of replaced person = 20 kg

Increase in average weight = 7.9 kg

**Formula Used:**

Weight of new person = Weight of replaced person + (Total members × Increase in average)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight increase of the group = 10 × 7.9

⇒ Total increase = 79 kg

⇒ Weight of the new person = 20 + 79

⇒ Weight of the new person = 99 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 99 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Replacement in Averages

When a new item replaces an old item, causing the average to increase, the value of the new item is calculated as: New Value = Old Value + (Total Items × Increase in Average).

Decrease in Average on Replacement

If the replacement causes the average to drop, it means the new item is smaller. The formula is: New Value = Old Value − (Total Items × Decrease in Average).

Addition of a New Member

When a completely new member joins the group (without replacing anyone) and changes the average: New Member's Value = Old Average + (New Total Members × Change in Average).
